unitTitle: Past Perfect Simple - Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Simple

pairsWith.noteUz: Past Perfect Simple mashqlari: shakl, by the time, gaplarni bog'lash, sabab.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 8-UNIT MAShQLAR (41-bet, PDF 40). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '8'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Past Perfect Simple':
1) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the past perfect.' 1 When we returned, we found that somebody ...... (broke into) our flat. 2 I ...... (not/finish) cooking dinner when my parents came to visit. 3 Jim went out for coffee after he ...... (write) a letter to his grandmother. 4 They left the cinema after the film ...... (end). 5 She was excited because she ...... (not/see) a play before. 6 Did you like the cake ...... (she/bake)? 7 He ...... (hear) the song on the radio before he bought the CD. 8 They were tired because they ...... (play) football. 9 She was sad because she ...... (lose) the game. 10 The match ...... (already/start) when they arrived at the stadium.
2) 'Look at the things Michael had/hadn't done by the time he was seven. Put a tick (✓) next to the things you had done and an (✗) next to the things you hadn't done. Then make sentences about you and Michael, as in the example.' JADVAL (Michael / You): started school ✓; travelled by train ✗; learned how to read ✓; seen a lot of films ✗. By the time Michael was 7 he had started school. By the time I was 7 I...

O'NG USTUN:
3) 'Join the sentences using the words in brackets and putting the verbs into the correct tense, as in the example.' 1 They watched TV. They finished their homework. (after) → They watched TV after they had finished their homework. 2 Jeff was 12 years old. He learned to speak English. (by the time) 3 Tim lived in London. He moved to Paris. (before) 4 Mum cooked dinner. I came home from school. (by the time) 5 She went to work. She had breakfast. (as soon as) 6 Susan tried on many dresses. She decided to buy the green one. (after) 7 Jason failed his driving test three times. He finally got his licence. (before) 8 Wendy finished the washing-up. She played chess. (after)
4) 'Complete the sentences using a verb from the list below.' bake, snow, win, walk, rain, watch, forget, not sleep, not clean, borrow. 1 The kitchen smelt delicious. Mum had just baked a cake. 2 The streets were wet. It ...... that morning. 3 Karen was locked out of her house. She ...... to take her keys. 4 My sister was angry with me. I ...... her dress without asking. 5 Gary's shoes were dirty. He ...... through mud. 6 The house was a mess. He ...... it for over a month. 7 The streets were covered with snow. It ...... heavily the night before. 8 Tom was exhausted. He ...... well. 9 Helen was very frightened. She ...... a horror film. 10 Alan bought a large house and an expensive car. He ...... the lottery.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '41'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the past perfect.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past perfect shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAD + V3 - OLDINROQ BO'LGAN
  HARAKAT.

  1 had broken into (qaytishdan
    oldin)
  2 hadn't finished (kelishdan
    oldin)
  3 had written (chiqishdan oldin)
  4 had ended
  5 hadn't seen a play before
  6 Had she baked (savol)
  7 had heard
  8 had played (charchaganning
    sababi)
  9 had lost
  10 had already started


⚠ 'TO BREAK INTO':

  = (uyga) bostirib kirmoq,
  o'g'irlik.


⚠ 'A PLAY':

  = spektakl.

items.textEn: When we returned, we found that somebody ___ (broke into) our flat.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Qaytishdan oldin bo'lgan → had broken into.

items.textEn: I ___ (not/finish) cooking dinner when my parents came to visit.
Jim went out for coffee after he ___ (write) a letter to his grandmother.
They left the cinema after the film ___ (end).
She was excited because she ___ (not/see) a play before.

items.whyUz: ⚠ U pishirgan tort (oldinroq) → she had baked.

items.textEn: He ___ (hear) the song on the radio before he bought the CD.
They were tired because they ___ (play) football.
She was sad because she ___ (lose) the game.
The match ___ (already/start) when they arrived at the stadium.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the things Michael had/hadn't done by the time he was seven. Put a tick next to the things you had done and a cross next to the things you hadn't done. Then make sentences about you and Michael, as in the example. Michael: started school ✓; travelled by train ✗; learned how to read ✓; seen a lot of films ✗.
exercises.instructionUz: Maykl yetti yoshga to'lguncha qilgan/qilmagan ishlariga qarang. O'zingiz qilgan ishlarga ✓, qilmaganlariga ✗ qo'ying. So'ng o'zingiz va Maykl haqida gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. Maykl: maktabga borgan ✓; poyezdda sayohat qilgan ✗; o'qishni o'rgangan ✓; ko'p film ko'rgan ✗.
exercises.explanationUz:
BY THE TIME + PAST SIMPLE, + PAST
  PERFECT.

  By the time Michael WAS 7 he
  HAD STARTED school. / HADN'T
  TRAVELLED by train.

  O'zingiz haqingizda - haqiqatga
  qarab ✓/✗.


⚠ 'BY THE TIME HE WAS SEVEN':

  = u yetti yoshga to'lguncha.
exercises.exampleEn: By the time Michael was 7 he had started school. By the time I was 7 I ...
exercises.exampleUz: Maykl 7 yoshga to'lguncha maktabga borgan edi. Men 7 yoshga to'lguncha ...
modelAnswers: By the time Michael was 7 he had started school. By the time I was 7 I had started school, too.
By the time Michael was 7 he hadn't travelled by train. By the time I was 7 I had travelled by train.
By the time Michael was 7 he had learned how to read. By the time I was 7 I had learned how to read, too.
By the time Michael was 7 he hadn't seen a lot of films. By the time I was 7 I had seen a lot of films.
modelAnswersUz: Maykl 7 yoshga to'lguncha maktabga borgan edi. Men ham 7 yoshga to'lguncha maktabga borgan edim. (NAMUNA)
Maykl 7 yoshga to'lguncha poyezdda sayohat qilmagan edi. Men esa poyezdda sayohat qilgan edim. (o'zingizga qarab)
Maykl 7 yoshga to'lguncha o'qishni o'rgangan edi. Men ham o'qishni o'rgangan edim.
Maykl 7 yoshga to'lguncha ko'p film ko'rmagan edi. Men esa ko'p film ko'rgan edim.

exercises.instructionEn: Join the sentences using the words in brackets and putting the verbs into the correct tense, as in the example. 1 They watched TV. They finished their homework. (after) → They watched TV after they had finished their homework. 2 Jeff was 12 years old. He learned to speak English. (by the time) 3 Tim lived in London. He moved to Paris. (before) 4 Mum cooked dinner. I came home from school. (by the time) 5 She went to work. She had breakfast. (as soon as) 6 Susan tried on many dresses. She decided to buy the green one. (after) 7 Jason failed his driving test three times. He finally got his licence. (before) 8 Wendy finished the washing-up. She played chess. (after)
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni qavsdagi so'zlar bilan bog'lang va fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying, namunadagidek. 1 Ular televizor ko'rishdi. Uy vazifasini tugatishdi. (after) → Uy vazifasini tugatgandan keyin televizor ko'rishdi. 2 Jeff 12 yoshda edi. Inglizcha gapirishni o'rgandi. (by the time) 3 Tim Londonda yashadi. Parijga ko'chdi. (before) 4 Oyim ovqat pishirdi. Men maktabdan keldim. (by the time) 5 U ishga ketdi. Nonushta qildi. (as soon as) 6 Syuzan ko'p ko'ylak kiyib ko'rdi. Yashilini olishga qaror qildi. (after) 7 Jeyson haydash imtihonidan uch marta yiqildi. Nihoyat guvohnoma oldi. (before) 8 Vendi idish yuvib bo'ldi. Shaxmat o'ynadi. (after)
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYSI HARAKAT OLDIN? → HAD V3.

  after / as soon as + OLDINGI
    (had V3), keyingi (V2)
  before + KEYINGI (V2), oldingi
    (had V3)
  by the time + KEYINGI (V2),
    oldingi (had V3)

  2 By the time Jeff was 12, he
    had learned ...
  3 Tim had lived in London before
    he moved to Paris.
  4 By the time I came home, Mum
    had cooked dinner.
  5 She went to work as soon as
    she had had breakfast.
  6 After Susan had tried on many
    dresses, she decided ...
  7 Jason had failed ... three
    times before he finally got
    ...
  8 After Wendy had finished the
    washing-up, she played chess.


⚠ 'TO TRY ON':

  = kiyib ko'rmoq.


⚠ 'A DRIVING LICENCE':

  = haydovchilik guvohnomasi.

modelAnswers: 1 They watched TV after they had finished their homework.
2 By the time Jeff was 12 years old, he had learned to speak English.
3 Tim had lived in London before he moved to Paris.
4 By the time I came home from school, Mum had cooked dinner.
5 She went to work as soon as she had had breakfast.
6 After Susan had tried on many dresses, she decided to buy the green one.
7 Jason had failed his driving test three times before he finally got his licence.
8 After Wendy had finished the washing-up, she played chess.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Ular uy vazifasini tugatgandan keyin televizor ko'rishdi. (NAMUNA)
2 Jeff 12 yoshga to'lguncha inglizcha gapirishni o'rgangan edi.
3 Tim Parijga ko'chishdan oldin Londonda yashagan edi.
4 Men maktabdan kelgunimcha oyim ovqat pishirgan edi.
5 U nonushta qilishi bilanoq ishga ketdi. (had had breakfast)
6 Syuzan ko'p ko'ylak kiyib ko'rgandan keyin yashilini olishga qaror qildi.
7 Jeyson nihoyat guvohnoma olishdan oldin haydash imtihonidan uch marta yiqilgan edi.
8 Vendi idish yuvib bo'lgandan keyin shaxmat o'ynadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences using a verb from the list below (in the past perfect).
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni ro'yxatdagi fe'l bilan (past perfect da) to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
NATIJA (Past Simple) ← SABAB
  (Past Perfect).

  1 smelt delicious ← had just
    BAKED (NAMUNA)
  2 streets wet ← had RAINED
  3 locked out ← had FORGOTTEN to
    take keys
  4 sister angry ← had BORROWED
    her dress
  5 shoes dirty ← had WALKED
    through mud
  6 house a mess ← HADN'T CLEANED
  7 covered with snow ← had SNOWED
  8 exhausted ← HADN'T SLEPT well
  9 frightened ← had WATCHED a
    horror film
  10 bought house and car ← had
     WON the lottery


⚠ 'TO BE LOCKED OUT':

  = eshik qulflanib tashqarida
  qolmoq.


⚠ 'A MESS':

  = tartibsizlik.


⚠ 'EXHAUSTED':

  = holdan toygan.

items.sentence: The kitchen smelt delicious. Mum ___ a cake.
items.uz: Oshxonadan mazali hid kelardi. Oyim endigina tort pishirgan edi. (NAMUNA)

items.sentence: The streets were wet. It ___ that morning.
items.uz: Ko'chalar ho'l edi. O'sha kuni ertalab yomg'ir yog'gan edi.

items.sentence: Karen was locked out of her house. She ___ to take her keys.
items.uz: Karen uyidan tashqarida qolib ketdi. U kalitlarini olishni unutgan edi.

items.sentence: My sister was angry with me. I ___ her dress without asking.
items.uz: Singlim mendan xafa edi. Men so'ramasdan uning ko'ylagini olgan edim.

items.sentence: Gary's shoes were dirty. He ___ through mud.
items.uz: Gerining tuflisi kir edi. U loydan yurgan edi.

items.sentence: The house was a mess. He ___ it for over a month.
items.uz: Uy tartibsiz edi. U bir oydan ortiq tozalamagan edi.

items.sentence: The streets were covered with snow. It ___ heavily the night before.
items.uz: Ko'chalar qor bilan qoplangan edi. Oldingi kecha qattiq qor yog'gan edi.
Tom holdan toygan edi. U yaxshi uxlamagan edi.

items.sentence: Helen was very frightened. She ___ a horror film.
items.uz: Helen juda qo'rqib ketgan edi. U qo'rqinchli film ko'rgan edi.

items.sentence: Alan bought a large house and an expensive car. He ___ the lottery.
items.uz: Alan katta uy va qimmat mashina sotib oldi. U lotereya yutgan edi.

patterns.formula: KIM + V2 + after + KIM + had + V3
patterns.exampleEn: They watched TV after they had finished their homework.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular uy vazifasini tugatgandan keyin televizor ko'rishdi.

patterns.formula: By the time + KIM + V2, KIM + had + V3
patterns.exampleEn: By the time Michael was 7 he had started school.
patterns.exampleUz: Maykl 7 yoshga to'lguncha maktabga borgan edi.

patterns.exampleEn: Tom was exhausted. He hadn't slept well.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom holdan toygan edi. U yaxshi uxlamagan edi.
